title: Essence Reborn
description: This plugin allows players to be imbued with the Essence of the mobs which they have slain, giving them special abilities!
body:
![Essence Reborn Cover Art](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/PufguM92/images/b56ba5884e4aafb0d99ef170f79075db056985f9.png)

# Essence Reborn ✨
Step into the world of mobs! Obtain the Essence of the mobs you slay and harness their wondrous abilities!

There are currently 8 Essence types: Chicken, Cow, Skeleton, Breeze, Piglin, Enderman, Wither, and Warden!
Each Essence provides powerful advantages in PvP.

Essence Reborn is mainly intended for PvP focused SMP servers, though it can still be enjoyed on other servers as well!

## How The Plugin Works
1. Kill mobs to have a chance at gaining their essence
2. Select an Essence
3. Use /crystal to get an Essence Crystal
4. Right Click / Sneak + Right Click whilst holding your Essence Crystal to activate your Weak and Strong Powers!
5. Each Essence also has a passive power!
6. Use an Essence Switcher to switch to a different Essence later on!

## Commands
### General
| Command             | Use                   |
|---------------------|-----------------------|
| /crystal            | Gives Essence Crystal used for activating powers |
| /myessence          | Shows descriptions for each essence you have unlocked|
| /selectessence      | Lets you pick a starting essence (1 time use)              |

### Admin (OP Only)
| Command             | Use                   |
|---------------------|-----------------------|
| /essence give essence {player} {type} {amount}| Gives the specified player the specified amount of the specified Essence type |
| /essence give switcher {player} {amount}| Gives the specified player the specified amount of Essence Switchers|
| /essence manage add {player} {type} {amount}| Adds the specified amount of the specified Essence type to the specified player |
| /essence manage remove {player} {type} {amount}| Removes the specified amount of the specified Essence type from the specified player |
| /essence manage disable {type} | Disables the specified Essence type |
| /essence manage enable {type} | Enables the specified Essence type |
| /essence manage select {player} {type} | Sets the specified player's active Essence to the specified Essence type|
| /essence manage view {player} | Brings up a menu that displays the amount of Essence of each type the specified player has and what powers the player has unlocked |
